applicant.organisation: Department of Health Economics, University of Vienna

purpose: We research insurance coverage gaps: whether people with type 2 diabetes in some regions are less likely to hold supplementary health insurance. Regional prevalence is the denominator for our survey weights.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
